key_observations: SPY above both 50DMA and 200DMA signals structural uptrend intact, but 1M performance of -0.58% indicates near-term consolidation pressure
QQQ 1M drawdown of -3.58% vs SPY -0.58% signals rotation away from mega-cap tech and rate-sensitive growth names
Bond yields surging to 15-16% range (per CoreWeave headline) represents a significant liquidity shock, pressuring high-duration and highly-leveraged assets
CPI-W at 3.9% and headline CPI at 3.7% in September confirm inflation remains elevated and above Fed target, reducing probability of near-term easing
Moderna +600% YTD driven by FDA approvals and Phase 3 oncology data signals biotech/healthcare innovation as a dominant alpha theme regardless of macro regime
CoreWeave -25% in one week on yield surge highlights vulnerability of AI infrastructure plays with heavy debt loads in a rising rate environment
SpaceX-Tesla merger exploration introduces idiosyncratic event risk in mega-cap tech/industrial space; outcome uncertain but sentiment-moving
VUG outperformance vs VBK (79% vs 17% over 5 years) confirms sustained large-cap growth factor dominance, though Shiller P/E near all-time highs signals valuation risk
Dividend-oriented consumer staples (PEP, MKC, HRL, CLX) near 52-week lows suggest value trap risk as consumer preference shifts and budget constraints persist
Overall regime is NEUTRAL with a growth tilt: equity trend is positive but rate environment, elevated inflation, and tech sector churn create cross-currents that prevent a clean RISK_ON read
